patterns.failure: Dispatch saved but LINE notification fails
patterns.required_response: Dispatch remains authoritative; record delivery failure and retry without duplicating dispatch.

patterns.failure: Dispatch saved but Google Calendar update fails
patterns.required_response: Persist projection failure, retry idempotently, expose reconciliation status.

patterns.failure: Google callback/token retry creates duplicate event
patterns.required_response: Use stable dispatch-to-event binding and idempotent update semantics.
Reject acknowledgement for superseded version and require current version acknowledgement.

patterns.failure: Concurrent dispatch edits overwrite one another
patterns.required_response: Use optimistic concurrency/version check and explicit conflict response.

patterns.failure: Permission scope changes while user session is active
patterns.required_response: Authorization is evaluated server-side on every protected operation; do not trust cached UI capability.

patterns.failure: Phase 2 photo upload succeeds but metadata write fails
patterns.required_response: No orphan becomes authoritative; reconcile/delete unreferenced objects.

patterns.failure: Old drawing is displayed as current
patterns.required_response: Current version is explicit and superseded versions cannot be presented as latest.
Use idempotency/source reference and prevent double costing.

patterns.failure: Cost source is corrected after project P&L calculation
patterns.required_response: Costs are traceable/reversible; recompute/project ledger reflects adjustment without losing history.

patterns.failure: Field user queues an acknowledgement offline and network returns after the dispatch was materially amended
patterns.required_response: Do not apply the stale acknowledgement; synchronize current dispatch version, mark queued action rejected/conflicted, and require acknowledgement of the current version.

patterns.failure: Offline cache is available after user permission or employment status is revoked
patterns.required_response: Apply cache TTL/user binding/revocation policy; on reconnect purge inaccessible data and reject queued actions that no longer authorize.

patterns.failure: Accounting export succeeds but local acknowledgement is lost
patterns.required_response: Retry by stable idempotency key and reconcile before creating a second provider transaction.

patterns.failure: Planned dispatch duration differs from actual approved labor time
patterns.required_response: Preserve both values; labor costing consumes approved labor time and retains traceability to dispatch/project/work log.
